name: AK38-Pump-Type Breathalyser
highlights: Electrochemical Sensing With a Pump — Two upgrades over every other breathalyser in the range: a fuel-cell style electrochemical sensor, and an internal pump that draws a measured sample rather than relying on how hard someone blew.

Why Both Matter Together — A semiconductor sensor responds to alcohol and to other vapours. An inconsistent breath sample produces an inconsistent reading. Fixing one without the other leaves the result arguable — this fixes both.

The Professional Tier — Where a result is recorded, acted on, or challenged — workplace testing, fleet operations, licensed premises — sensor class and sampling method are the first two questions asked.
Runs on Two AA Cells — No charging cycle to manage between shifts, and spare cells cost nothing to keep on hand.
100 Per Carton — 425 × 422 × 310 mm outer, 16.55 kg gross — heavier per unit than the semiconductor models because of the pump assembly.
